scientific_role: schema-and-optics-informed independent-provider domain-shift diagnostic; not a pristine source-selection holdout

source_contract.provider: Image Data Resource / University of Dundee

field_and_channel_contract.field_resolution: parse the one-based Field number from the frozen IDR image name and select Image elements whose integer Sublayout equals that field
field_and_channel_contract.z_resolution: within the selected sublayout, group repeated role-matched pages by role; maximum-project only if more than one page for a role shares the same sublayout
field_and_channel_contract.light_source_rule: the selected sublayout's referenced LightSourceCombination must contain 488 and one of 635 or 640 nm; camera and emission filter uniquely assign roles
field_and_channel_contract.resolution_rule: after sublayout filtering, each page must map to at most one role and both roles must have at least one page

pixel_preprocessing_contract.per_channel_scaling: finite p1/p99 clipping to [0,1] with all-zero output when p99 is not above p1
pixel_preprocessing_contract.geometry: center-crop to square then area-resize to 128x128

evaluation_contract.thresholds_temperature_and_conformal: use frozen HPA checkpoint values unchanged
evaluation_contract.prediction_aggregation: image diagnostics plus arithmetic-mean logits per landmark protein and plate

failure_policy.endpoint_failure: retain as consumed independent-provider diagnostic only
failure_policy.endpoint_success: record optics-informed independent-provider domain-shift support without pristine or uncertainty authority
